title: nymphoides tonkinensis
intro: Nymphoides tonkinensis, commonly known as the water frangipani, is a plant species in the family Menyanthaceae. This aquatic plant is traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Nymphoides tonkinensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
